requirements.title: Bottle and Cloud-Slogan Illustration
requirements.definition: Create the independently reviewed illustration centered on a bottle with slogan text presented above it in a cloud, sky, or text-bubble treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: The bottle composition, location wording, typography, and sky-text arrangement are attributes of one illustration; the meat-stamp and grill-smoke illustrations are separate deliverables with independent revisions.

requirements.title: Meat and Stamped-Slogan Illustration
requirements.definition: Create the independently reviewed cartoon illustration in which the slogan appears stamped onto the meat.
requirements.boundary_note: Cartoon styling, tortilla appearance, steak streak placement, and stamped-text appearance are visual attributes of this single illustration rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Grill and Smoke-Slogan Illustration
requirements.definition: Create the independently reviewed cartoon grill illustration with steak and onions and a readable smoke-like rendering of the slogan.
requirements.boundary_note: Grill contents, steak shape, smoke styling, and text readability are attributes of this illustration; it can be revised and accepted independently of the other two designs.

requirements.title: Original Non-Plagiarized Artwork
requirements.definition: Produce original artwork rather than copying or plagiarizing existing illustrations.
requirements.boundary_note: This originality constraint is established by the project description and applies across the three illustrations; it is separate from the prohibition on AI tools because either constraint could be evaluated independently.

requirements.title: No AI Tools for Artwork Completion
requirements.definition: Complete the illustration work manually without using AI-generation tools.
requirements.boundary_note: The project description directly prohibits AI tools, while the freelancer's hand-drawn commitment corroborates manual production; this constraint is independent of each illustration's visual content.

requirements.title: Final PNG and JPG Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver the completed illustration assets in the client-selected PNG and JPG raster formats.
requirements.boundary_note: File-format delivery is a shared output obligation independent of the visual requirements for each illustration and of requests for specific background variants.

requirements.title: Green-Background and Background-Free PNG Variants
requirements.definition: Export the identified completed illustrations as both green-background PNGs and PNGs without the green background.
requirements.boundary_note: The paired background exports form one repeated delivery mechanism and can be fulfilled independently of the underlying illustration revisions and general PNG/JPG format selection.

requirements.title: Standalone Strawberry Composition PNG
requirements.definition: Deliver the requested strawberry composition as a separate PNG asset containing the intended complete bottle and associated grill or smoke elements.
requirements.boundary_note: This derivative PNG is independently delivered and has its own clipping and bottle-label correction trajectory, so it should not be merged into the primary illustration or generic format Requirements.

unresolved_candidates.description: The freelancer promised hand-drawn vector illustrations and source files, but the client later selected PNG and JPG when asked to choose between AI and PSD. It is unclear whether editable source files became an authoritative additional deliverable or were superseded by raster-only delivery.

The three feedback messages likely correspond to the three separate illustrations, but absent attachment context prevents fully certain routing of every revision, especially the generic cartoon-style request in message 32.
The font, two-line arrangement, revised slogan wording, and spelling correction are clear changes, but the text alone does not conclusively identify which illustration received them.
The requested clearing of a dark background around an unspecified word depends on unavailable visual context and cannot yet be routed safely to a particular illustration.
The final correction is referenced only as 'Just this' with missing visual context, so its target behavior cannot be identified safely.
